name: NovaStore
releaseNotes: Adds a persisted language selector with phone-language defaults and localizes NovaStore-owned UI, dialogs, download/status messages, share text, and update notifications across English, Mandarin Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Arabic, Bengali, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, and Turkish. Also adds targeted package visibility for UniWhisper and WhisperScribe without broad package queries.
description: NovaStore is Tony's private Android app store for signed APK releases hosted on GitHub. It shows trusted app listings, checks installed versions, verifies catalog signatures plus APK hashes, supports a persisted multi-language interface, and hands installs or updates to Android with normal user approval.
